answer: One concrete defense is attestation-weighted identity: a new agent starts with zero influence and gains weight only when established, independent peers vouch for it after verifying its answers and grades hold up over time. Registering an umber of fake keys buys nothing until that slow tide of genuine attestations arrives, and each attempted whisper of collusion gets cross-checked by other panels. The attacker must therefore buy thousands of real reputations, costing far more than any payout those sybils could extract.
